{
  "dataset_name": "qsar_biodegradation",
  "model_family": "tree",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "molecular_complexity_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Composite molecular complexity combining atom count proxy (V1), branching (V7), and ring-related features (V3). Higher values indicate more complex molecular structures.",
      "formula": "V1 * np.log1p(V7 + 1) + np.log1p(V3)",
      "value_range": [2.0, 25.0],
      "feature_family": "molecular_structure",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Tree splits on this composite can separate simple vs complex molecules which often differ in biodegradability",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "polarity_asymmetry",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute difference between two polarity-related descriptors V12 and V14, capturing asymmetry in charge distribution. Large values indicate highly polar or asymmetric molecules.",
      "formula": "np.abs(V12 - V14)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 9.75],
      "feature_family": "electronic_properties",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Polarity asymmetry is a key driver of biodegradability; tree thresholds on this can isolate polar vs nonpolar compounds",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "heteroatom_density",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of heteroatom-related count (V9 + V6) to molecular size proxy V1. Higher density suggests more reactive functional groups.",
      "formula": "(V9 + V6) / (V1 + 1e-6)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 7.5],
      "feature_family": "molecular_composition",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Heteroatom density directly relates to biodegradability pathways; enables clean threshold splits",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "aromatic_fraction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Fraction of aromatic-related atoms (V5) relative to total atom count proxy (V16 + V5 + 1). Captures aromaticity level of the molecule.",
      "formula": "V5 / (V16 + V5 + 1.0)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 0.97],
      "feature_family": "molecular_structure",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aromatic compounds tend to be less biodegradable; this fraction enables direct boolean splits",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "log_molecular_weight_proxy",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed proxy for molecular weight using V39 (a size-related descriptor). Compresses the heavy tail of large molecules.",
      "formula": "np.log1p(V39)",
      "value_range": [1.7, 2.8],
      "feature_family": "molecular_size",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Log-transformed size features provide better split points for tree models on skewed distributions",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "connectivity_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of two topological connectivity indices V2 and V13. Captures relative branching and connectivity structure.",
      "formula": "V2 / (V13 + 1e-6)",
      "value_range": [0.14, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "topological",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Connectivity ratio captures structural topology differences that tree models can exploit with threshold splits",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "has_nitrogen_oxygen_groups",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Boolean indicator (0/1) for presence of nitrogen or oxygen functional groups based on V4 > 0 or V20 > 0. Indicates reactive heteroatom groups.",
      "formula": "np.where((V4 > 0) | (V20 > 0), 1, 0)",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "functional_groups",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Boolean indicator enables direct binary splits; nitrogen/oxygen groups strongly influence biodegradation pathways",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "ring_complexity_bucket",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal bucket (0-3) for ring system complexity based on V3 count: 0=no rings, 1=1 ring, 2=2-3 rings, 3=4+ rings.",
      "formula": "np.where(V3 == 0, 0, np.where(V3 == 1, 1, np.where(V3 <= 3, 2, 3)))",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "molecular_structure",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Ordinal ring buckets allow tree models to split on ring complexity levels directly without numeric noise",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "electrotopological_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Product of electrotopological state V36 and V37, capturing nonlinear interaction between two electrotopological descriptors.",
      "formula": "V36 * V37",
      "value_range": [3.3, 62.3],
      "feature_family": "electronic_properties",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Nonlinear interaction term captures joint effects that individual features miss; tree models benefit from pre-computed interactions",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "molecular_flexibility_index",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of rotatable bond count proxy (V10) to total heavy atom count proxy (V1). Higher values indicate more flexible molecules.",
      "formula": "V10 / (V1 + 1e-6)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.5],
      "feature_family": "molecular_structure",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Molecular flexibility affects biodegradation rate; this ratio normalizes for molecule size enabling better splits",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "halogen_presence_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of halogen-related structural features based on V26 (halogen count proxy) and V29 (halogen indicator). Score 0=no halogens, 1=low halogen content, 2=moderate, 3=high halogen content. Halogens strongly reduce biodegradability.",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "functional_groups",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Halogen content is a strong predictor of biodegradability resistance; ordinal score enables direct tree splits",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "descriptor_deviation_from_mean",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized deviation of V8 (a key physicochemical descriptor) from its training mean (37.06), normalized by training std (9.14). Captures how atypical a molecule is on this descriptor.",
      "formula": "np.abs(V8 - 37.06) / 9.14",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.1],
      "feature_family": "statistical_deviation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Deviation from typical values identifies outlier molecules; tree thresholds on deviation can isolate unusual compounds with distinct biodegradability",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
